findings.summary: Frozen rows classify ingredient claims from Toast and unextracted official PDF/image menus as official-ingredients. Reopened Toast is only restaurant_linked_vendor; its descriptions support narrow positive identities only, not complete arrays, negatives, or cross-contact claims.

Luna incorrectly associated baseline key 15:dinner-steak-frites with Salade Maison. The independently reopened Toast catalog shows it is a duplicate-presentation/normalized match for current product steak-frites; Salade Maison matches only 32:salade-maison.

The official menu index says plat du jour and weekend specials may not be listed, and the linked official PDF/image surfaces were not extractable. Therefore no source absence is a verified removal, no complete current all-product catalog is established, and no allergen negative or cross-contact conclusion is supportable.

verifier.summary: Discrepancy found. Bar Colline identity and official-linked Toast takeaway catalog were verified; every Scout surface, 20 current products, and all 41 frozen keys were independently reconciled. The catalog is not complete because official PDF/image menus were unextractable and the official index permits unlisted specials. Existing official-ingredients authority is not substantiated: Toast evidence remains restaurant_linked_vendor and supports only narrow named positive allergens, never complete arrays, negatives, or cross-contact conclusions.
